source.title: The Coffee Folk: Hario Skerton Pro (cold brew 12–16)

procedure.en: Turn the adjustment nut under the burr clockwise until it is tight and the burrs touch. That is zero. Count clicks counter-clockwise from there. Do not grind at zero: the ceramic burrs rub.
procedure.pt-BR: Gire a porca de ajuste sob a mó no sentido horário até apertar e as mós se tocarem. Esse é o zero. Conte os cliques no sentido anti-horário a partir dali. Não moa no zero: as mós de cerâmica se atritam.

notes: Hario's manual gives no click numbers, only 'rotate to the right for finer, to the left for coarser' and a Fine / Medium-fine / Medium / Coarse chart. Clicks per rotation are not published; Homegrounds counts about 10 usable sizes at roughly 100 µm of travel per step. Bands are the midpoint of reviewer counts (Coffee Chronicler, Homegrounds, The Coffee Folk, Brew Coffee Home, Balance Journal). Honest Coffee Guide's chart (notches 0–9, 350–1400 µm) is on a different scale and duplicates its Skerton Plus chart, so it is not used as a fallback here.
